title: Bitcoin Warning: Why BTC Hasn't Bottomed — Plus ETH, SOL, XRP & Altcoin Targets
description:
Gareth Soloway, Chief Market Strategist at Verified Investing, breaks down the latest crypto price action across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Avalanche, Chainlink, and Cardano — with clear near-term targets and a critical macro warning that most traders are ignoring.

Bitcoin may have short-term upside toward $80K, but the bigger chart pattern tells a very different story. Here's what to watch before the next major move.

 In this episode:

₿ Bitcoin (BTC) — Bear flag macro setup, near-term neutral-to-bullish bias, and downside targets at $50K and $30K
Ξ Ethereum (ETH) — Megaphone pattern with resistance at $2,600–$2,800
◎ Solana (SOL) — Short-term breakout in play, target $115–$120
✕ XRP — Bullish near-term move, key resistance at $1.60 and $1.80
❄️ Avalanche (AVAX) — Wedge breakout, target $10.50–$11.40
🔗 Chainlink (LINK) — Similar breakout pattern to SOL and AVAX
₳ Cardano (ADA) — Breakout above downsloping resistance, target $0.29–$0.33
